d: Company Description FansPass | فانز باس is a Saudi-based ticket marketplace that allows fans to buy and sell tickets for sports, entertainment, concerts, and global events through a secure, user-friendly platform. The company focuses on creating a trusted environment by connecting verified buyers and sellers. FansPass provides guarantees and responsive customer support to ensure safe and smooth transactions. The platform is designed for ease of use, enabling fans to access events locally and internationally with confidence. Team members contribute to a growing digital marketplace that supports the entertainment and sports ecosystem in the region.

Role Description The Accountant role at FansPass | فانز باس is a full-time remote position responsible for managing day-to-day financial operations. This includes recording and reconciling transactions, processing invoices and payments, maintaining the general ledger, and preparing regular financial reports. The Accountant will monitor accounts receivable and payable, support monthly and annual closing activities, and assist with budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow tracking. The role also involves ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards, internal controls, and local regulations, as well as supporting audits and responding to finance-related inquiries from internal stakeholders.
q: li
Strong financial accounting and reporting skills, including experience with general ledger management, reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.
li
Proficiency with accounting software and financial tools (e.g., ERP systems, spreadsheets), and ability to work with digital platforms and online payment systems.
li
Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management, with the ability to analyze financial data and provide clear insights.
li
Understanding of internal controls, compliance, and audit processes, including familiarity with relevant accounting standards and local regulations.
li
Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a remote environment.
li
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are a plus.
li
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or ticketing platforms is advantageous, as well as prior experience in a remote or distributed work setting.

d: We're looking for a data-driven planning professional who thrives in a fast-paced automotive environment and can balance customer demand with inventory optimization. Join Jaidah Group as a Demand & Supply Specialist and play a critical role in ensuring the right vehicles are available at the right time, supporting sales growth, customer satisfaction, and profitability across our automotive business. This role works closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics teams, and OEM partners to forecast demand, optimize stock levels, and manage the vehicle ordering lifecycle from production through delivery
Develop and manage monthly vehicle order plans by model, grade, channel, and colour mix.
Analyze sales trends, market demand, stock levels, and pipeline data to determine optimal ordering requirements.
Maintain healthy inventory levels while minimizing overstock and stock shortages.
Prepare sales, stock, and order forecasts, incorporating production schedules, shipment updates, and expected arrivals.
Monitor inventory ageing and slow-moving stock, recommending corrective actions to mitigate risk.
Collaborate with manufacturers and OEM partners to align production allocations, order volumes, and delivery timelines.
Manage vehicle orders through manufacturer portals and track progress from production to arrival.
Partner with Sales, Product, Pricing, and Marketing teams to support new model launches, campaigns, and forecasting activities.
Support annual budgeting and business planning through accurate volume and sales forecasting.
Prepare management reports and dashboards covering demand, supply, inventory, pipeline, ageing, and forecast performance.
Identify supply risks, logistics disruptions, and commercial challenges, providing proactive recommendations and mitigation plans.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, Marketing, Automotive Management, Finance, or a related field.

3-5 years of experience in demand planning, sales planning, inventory control, product planning, or automotive sales coordination. Experience within a premium or luxury automotive brand is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory management, sales planning, stock ageing, and order management processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
Experience working with CRM, ERP/DMS platforms, and reporting tools.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and with OEM partners.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Understanding of the Qatar/GCC automotive market, customer trends, and premium brand standards is an advantage.

At Jaidah Group, we believe our people are our greatest strength. Join a dynamic team that values innovation, growth, and excellence in everything we do. We offer a supportive work environment, continuous learning opportunities, competitive compensation, and comprehensive benefits designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.
The position is responsible for generating sales and deliver customer service at its best.
Support the other operational duties such as housekeeping, visual presentation standards, etc. as assigned by the Store Management Team.

Provides important visual cues for guests that make a positive first impression E.g. wearing proper career wear that is clean and neatly pressed, maintaining a clean parking lot/exterior and a clean and inviting dining room.
Follows the guaranteed Always Fresh procedure to ensure coffee and products are always fresh and always accurate.
Delivers consistent and outstanding guest service through friendly attitude, attentive behavior and strong product knowledge.
Enhances the guest experience by following the S.E.T. Principles: Smile, Eye Contact, Thank You.
Uses proper procedures to ensure the accuracy of every order for every guest.
Ensures every guest receives a prompt and warm greeting within 5 seconds at front counter and drive-thru.
Maintains speed of service targets by working efficiently with a sense of urgency to fill orders and meet guests’ needs.
Promptly executes service recovery for any guest concerns or complaints by making it right with the guest, regardless of involvement in the issue.
Listens carefully to guests and apologizes for the experience in the case of a complaint. Store Operations
Follows all Operations standards and guidelines for preparation of products according to training and instructional materials provided.
Prepares all products as required, following the order monitor to ensure the accuracy of every order.
Communicates showcase and product needs to ensure proper product availability for guests.
Regularly takes temperatures of the required products and records in the Time & Temperature Log. Policies and Procedures
Participates in and attends all store meetings and other related functions.
Follows all restaurant policies, procedures and standards.
Maintains the front counter by keeping it clean, organized, stocked and ready for rush periods in the restaurant.
Follows proper hand washing techniques and all sanitation guidelines; completes all sanitation tasks as outlined by the Store Manager. Cashiering
Receives payment by cash, credit cards, vouchers or automatic debits.
Issue receipts, refunds, or change to the customers correctly.
Count money in the cash till at the beginning of the shifts to ensure that amount is correct and there is adequate change.
Maintain clean and orderly checkout areas. Health & Safety
Works in compliance with occupational health and safety legislation.
Knows, understands and follows safe work practices and procedures.
Uses or wears personal protective equipment or clothing as required.

Reports all injuries/illnesses, accidents, unsafe conditions, security incidents and any contravention of health and safety legislation, policies and procedures to the Restaurant Manager or Restaurant Owner.

The Pepperstone story started in 2010. We know what it’s like to trade the world’s markets. Our team describes us as a place for the curious and the driven, and we like to do things a little differently; as a transformative global fintech, we’re digital, nimble, connected, and united in our vision to create a better way to trade.

We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global, and results-focused. You’ll find our 550+ team currently across 11 locations and 9 time zones.

The Trading Platform Architect is an elite individual contributor role responsible for the long-term technical vision, scalability, and performance of Pepperstone’s core trading ecosystems and liquidity routing infrastructure. This role sits above day-to-day operations to spearhead our largest, highest-stakes infrastructure projects, such as multi-asset bridging configurations, global ultra-low latency server network designs, and complex LP integrations. You will act as the primary technical authority on platform architecture, ensuring our ecosystem is robust, secure, and built for massive volume growth, with no direct reports or line-management responsibilities.
q: li
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Financial Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
li
5 to 10 years of hands-on experience specifically within the FX/CFD broker or institutional trading landscape.
li
Mastery of trading platform server backends, with expert-level configuration knowledge of MT4, MT5, and cTrader.
li
Expert knowledge of Liquidity Bridge Providers, specifically advanced configuration and aggregation logic in OneZero Hub and PrimeXM XCore.
li
Deep understanding of the FIX protocol (FIX 4.2 / 4.4) and low-latency network infrastructure engineering.
li
Proficiency in database management and analytics, specifically writing advanced SQL queries for trade data and server log analysis.
li
Proven track record of independently delivery massive, complex fintech infrastructure projects from conception to completion
r: Design and architect the global deployment, topology, and failover logic of MT4, MT5, cTrader, and TradingView server environments
Own the lifecycle of major infrastructure projects, including bridge migrations, cross-region server deployments, and new technology vendor integrations
Optimize and scale liquidity bridging infrastructure (OneZero, PrimeXM) and advanced aggregation engines to minimize execution latency and slippage
Engineer robust FIX API connectivity and custom routing rules to maximize execution quality across multiple Liquidity Providers (LPs)
Conduct deep-dive technical diagnostics on complex structural platform anomalies, infrastructure bottlenecks, and feed pricing logic
Collaborate as a strategic technical advisor with internal IT, DevOps, Trading Operations, and external institutional technology partners
Ensure architectural compliance with global financial regulations and strict institutional security standards
Why you will enjoy working with us

Periodic recognition and reward programs for outstanding performance and achievements
